pages.title: VELLARIO · COMO
pages.lead: La Dolce Vita, sull'Acqua. A distinctly Italian expression of design, elegance and the pleasure of life on the water.

sections.title: Dove Tutto Comincia
sections.body: There are places whose character is inseparable from the way they are lived. Lake Como is one of them: architecture set against the mountains, gardens descending towards the water, and a distinctive tradition of arriving by boat. For VELLARIO, Como is not merely a location or a backdrop. It is the cultural inspiration for a new nautical point of view.
sections.shortIntro: Como è il nostro punto di partenza: paesaggio, architettura e una tradizione di eleganza sull’acqua.

sections.title: La Dolce Vita sull'Acqua
sections.body: An aperitivo at the water's edge. The golden light of late afternoon. A short passage across the lake, with no need to hurry. La Dolce Vita is not a style borrowed for a photograph; it is the pleasure of living beautifully, simply and without ostentation. This is the spirit we want VELLARIO to express.
sections.englishLine: The Good Life, the Italian Way
sections.shortIntro: Un aperitivo sul lago, la luce del tramonto, il piacere di navigare senza fretta. Questa è la Dolce Vita.

sections.title: La Collezione
sections.body: A collection should never feel like a row of interchangeable objects. Quantum 999, MAS 36, MAS 56, GranTender 72 and Gran Marlin explore different expressions of life on the water, from the spirit of the Italian sporting boat to the architectural ambition of a larger yacht. Each begins with its own design character.
sections.shortIntro: Cinque barche, cinque caratteri. Un'unica interpretazione della Dolce Vita sull’acqua.

sections.title: Storia & Tradizione
sections.body: Long before the idea of VELLARIO, generations of boatbuilders, racers and craftsmen shaped the nautical culture of Lake Como. Their world was one of working boats and elegant runabouts, ingenuity and competition, skilled hands and bold ideas. It remains a source of inspiration for a new expression of Italian nautical elegance.

sections.title: L'Arte del Dettaglio
sections.body: The Italian idea of saper fare is more than craftsmanship alone. It is the discipline of knowing why a detail matters. Proportion, materials, the line of a hull and the feeling of a surface should belong to one coherent whole. For VELLARIO, beauty starts with these decisions.
sections.shortIntro: Proporzioni, materiali, linee e superfici: il saper fare italiano si riconosce nei dettagli.

sections.title: La Casa VELLARIO
sections.body: La Casa VELLARIO is conceived as a new Italian nautical design house: distinctive in character, discreet in expression, personal in its approach. The ambition is to direct the design, identity and future client experience of a carefully considered collection—not to pursue volume or spectacle.
sections.englishLine: A Distinctly Italian Point of View

sections.title: Un Invito Personale
sections.body: A boat becomes personal through thoughtful choices, not endless options. Su Misura is the Italian expression of this attention to the individual. The future VELLARIO relationship with its owners is envisaged as a conversation guided by taste, design and a shared appreciation of beauty.

pages.title: Como
pages.lead: Il Lario. An enduring meeting of water, architecture and Italian elegance.

sections.title: Il Lario
sections.body: Il Lario has its own rhythm. Mountains fall steeply towards the water, villages gather around little harbours, and the changing light transforms the landscape throughout the day. This is a place best understood slowly, sometimes from the shore and sometimes from the deck of a boat.

sections.title: Le Ville
sections.body: The great villas of Como were designed to be experienced within their setting, not separated from it. At Villa del Balbianello, on the wooded Lavedo peninsula, architecture, terraces and gardens form an extraordinary composition above the lake. Its history belongs to those who created and preserved it; its sense of proportion offers a lasting lesson in elegance.

sections.title: L'Arte dell'Approdo
sections.body: There is a particular pleasure in the approach: a distant villa becomes a recognisable silhouette, a stone pontile appears, and a familiar shore reveals itself differently from the water. L'arte dell'approdo—the art of arriving—is part of the life and character of Como.

sections.title: Tradizione Nautica
sections.body: Como's relationship with boats reaches far beyond leisure. Workboats, sailing craft, passenger vessels, racing machines and classic motorboats have all left their mark on its shores. The Museo Barca Lariana at Pianello del Lario preserves a remarkable record of this culture, making the lake's boating history tangible through vessels, engines, documents and stories.

sections.title: La Nostra Ispirazione
sections.body: The past is not a template to reproduce. It is a standard to understand. Inspired by Como's landscape, architecture and boating culture, VELLARIO aims to develop a contemporary design identity that feels at ease beside what has endured: unmistakably new, yet sensitive to the spirit of the place.

pages.title: La Dolce Vita
pages.kicker: 02 / La Dolce Vita · L'Arte di Vivere
pages.lead: Il piacere di vivere. Unhurried days, extraordinary places and life on the water.

sections.title: Il Tempo
sections.body: Il tempo is perhaps the greatest luxury. The freedom to follow the light, stay for one more conversation or choose the longer route home. In the Italian understanding of la dolce vita, time is not simply spent: it is enjoyed, generously and beautifully.

sections.title: Il Piacere di Navigare
sections.body: The pleasure of a passeggiata on the water has little to do with distance. It is the changing view, the sound of the lake and the quiet sense of being exactly where one wants to be. Il piacere di navigare belongs to the experience, not to a number on a specification sheet.

sections.title: Eleganza Senza Ostentazione
sections.body: Eleganza senza ostentazione. True Italian elegance does not need to announce itself. It lives in proportion, hospitality, a confident gesture and the art of choosing just enough. A beautiful boat should share that same natural sprezzatura: a sense of ease made possible by careful thought.

sections.title: La Vita a Bordo
sections.body: La vita a bordo begins with the people who share it. A quiet corner in the sun, the pleasure of an aperitivo, space for conversation and the freedom to be alone when desired. These moments give direction to a design long before its final arrangements are defined.

sections.title: La Collezione
sections.body: A collection is an expression of character, not simply of size or category. The five VELLARIO design studies are different invitations to experience the water. Discover the distinct intentions behind Quantum 999, MAS 36, MAS 56, GranTender 72 and Gran Marlin.

pages.title: La Collezione
pages.lead: Cinque barche. Cinque personalità. Five original nautical design studies.

sections.title: Ogni Barca, un Carattere
sections.body: Some boats express their character through pure lines, others through movement, versatility or presence. The VELLARIO collection brings together five different projects from the original design archive. They are presented individually because each deserves a voice of its own. Explore the concepts through their original imagery and the design ideas that shaped them.

sections.title: La Forma del Desiderio
sections.body: Every VELLARIO design begins with an idea of character. These five studies come from an original nautical design archive, where each silhouette and arrangement was developed around its own intentions. The images offer a first encounter with these ideas; the design house's next chapter is to refine their distinct personalities into a coherent collection.

sections.title: Su Misura
sections.body: Su Misura is not the promise of unlimited choice. It is the ability to understand an individual taste and translate it into thoughtful details without losing the character of the design. The scope of VELLARIO personalisation will be established through future product development.
sections.englishLine: The Art of Making It Personal

sections.title: Un Invito Personale
sections.body: A memorable experience begins long before a boat enters the water. The VELLARIO approach to the future owner relationship is intended to be personal, discreet and informed by design. Discover the collection, understand the characters and follow the design house as that relationship takes shape.

pages.englishTagline: For the Love of the Water

pages.title: Storia & Tradizione
pages.lead: La tradizione del lago. A genuine culture of Italian boating and innovation.

sections.title: La Vita sul Lago
sections.body: Lake Como has long depended on boats for more than pleasure. Fishing, trade, transport and daily work shaped the vessels of its shores. Over time, sailing, motoring and competition added new forms of ingenuity. This layered relationship with the water—practical, social and inventive—is an essential part of the Larian nautical story.

sections.title: Le Barche del Lario
sections.body: The boats preserved on the Lario reveal a rich range of purposes and characters: traditional rowing boats, sailing vessels, working craft and the increasingly sophisticated motorboats of the twentieth century. At the Museo Barca Lariana, vessels such as the Serie Laghi and Colombo Super Rockett 007 connect visitors to different moments in the evolution of design and performance.

sections.title: Maestria e Coraggio
sections.body: Speed on water has always demanded more than an attractive hull. It calls for skill in materials, geometry, mechanics and judgement. The boatbuilding culture of the lake includes the work of designers, craftsmen and racing pioneers whose ideas were tested on the water itself. Their achievements belong to their own people and companies; they help us understand the standards a new nautical project should aspire to.

sections.title: Custodire la Memoria
sections.body: In 1978, enthusiasts began collecting and safeguarding the boating heritage of the Lario. The Museo Barca Lariana opened at Pianello del Lario in 1982, within a former nineteenth-century silk mill, and reopened in 2018 after a long closure. Its continuing research and restoration work reminds us that real heritage is made of objects, knowledge and evidence—not simply an evocative word in a brand story.

sections.title: Il Futuro della Tradizione
sections.body: La tradizione is not a story to borrow. The boatbuilders, craftsmen and racing pioneers of Lake Como created their own history. VELLARIO looks to their pursuit of beauty and technical ingenuity as an inspiration for something new, without claiming their achievements as its own.

pages.title: Design & Saper Fare
pages.lead: L'Arte del Dettaglio. Character, proportion and the discipline behind beauty.

sections.title: Le Proporzioni
sections.body: The character of a boat begins in its proportions: the relationship between length and height, the tension of a surface, the position of a cockpit, the moment a sheerline meets the stern. These decisions shape how a design is recognised long before its details are noticed. The ambition for VELLARIO is to develop an original language that is expressive without being fashionable.

sections.title: Il Segno
sections.body: A memorable exterior should be unmistakable from a distance and rewarding up close. The model studies explore different characters rather than a single formula applied at different sizes. As the range develops, our task is to identify the proportions, graphic signatures and architectural principles that can connect them as a family without compromising what makes each one distinctive.

sections.title: La Materia
sections.body: La materia tells part of the story of every important object. The feeling of a handrail, the meeting of two surfaces, the finish around a control: small gestures of design that deserve the greatest care. VELLARIO's intended material language is rooted in authenticity, restraint and the Italian idea of saper fare.

sections.title: Bellezza e Ingegneria
sections.body: A boat is architecture in motion. The beauty of its proportions must coexist with the demands of balance, structure, ergonomics and the sea. For this reason, design and naval engineering cannot be separate conversations. As the collection develops, technical expertise must strengthen the character of every project rather than dilute it.

sections.title: Su Misura
sections.body: Su Misura means making a design personal without making it lose itself. We envisage a considered approach to colours, finishes and details that respects the character of each boat. Every future choice must be as technically credible as it is aesthetically distinctive.

pages.title: La Casa VELLARIO
pages.lead: La Casa VELLARIO. An Italian design house built around elegance, identity and individuality.

sections.title: La Visione
sections.body: La Casa VELLARIO begins with one conviction: a boat can be valued as a work of design, admired for its identity, precision and individuality as much as for the moments it makes possible. The ambition is a considered collection, not a catalogue without limits.

sections.title: L'Anima Italiana
sections.body: Italianità is more than a place of origin. It is a way of seeing: an understanding of beauty, the pleasure of good design, hospitality and the confidence of simplicity. The Lago di Como provides our inspiration; the wider Italian culture of saper fare gives meaning to the direction we intend to follow.

sections.title: Il Nostro Metodo
sections.body: The proposed VELLARIO model places design and identity at the centre. The design house intends to guide styling, product development, the selection of materials, quality expectations and the relationship with each future client. Specialised construction is envisaged through carefully selected partner shipyards. This structure allows the brand to concentrate its attention where it matters most: on the character of each boat and the experience around it.

sections.title: La Relazione
sections.body: Il piacere di conoscersi: the pleasure of getting to know one another. A meaningful luxury relationship should begin with a conversation, not a checkout. We envisage a discreet, direct exchange in which individual preferences meet a clear and recognisable VELLARIO design identity.

sections.title: Il Futuro
sections.body: A new design house takes shape one decision at a time: defining its identity, refining a collection, bringing design and technical disciplines together, and choosing the people able to realise its ambition. VELLARIO's future will be measured less by the number of boats it introduces than by the distinctiveness and integrity of each one.

pages.title: Contatti
pages.lead: Il piacere di conoscersi. Every lasting relationship begins with a conversation.

sections.title: Il Piacere di Conoscersi
sections.body: A relationship with VELLARIO is intended to begin with an appreciation of design and a shared understanding of what makes a boat personal. The design house is taking shape around a carefully selected collection and an individual approach to future clients. Its public story begins here, with the vision and the work behind it.

sections.title: Un Contatto Personale
sections.body: A dedicated channel for personal introductions will be announced as the design house develops. Until then, the collection and the story of VELLARIO can be explored here without registration or the sharing of personal information.

sections.title: Riservatezza
sections.body: A relationship built on discretion deserves a correspondingly careful approach to information. Before enquiries are accepted, VELLARIO intends to establish a clear process for contact requests, personal data and responses. No contact information is collected on this preview site.

quantum-999.lead: Quantum 999 introduces a contemporary design study focused on visual clarity, movement and a recognisable personality. Its original yacht renderings provide the starting point for a future VELLARIO interpretation.
quantum-999.concept: Quantum 999 is an exercise in making a boat feel purposeful without relying on decoration or historical quotation. The original archive offers a distinctive visual direction from which to explore the relationship between an exterior identity and the experience of time on the water. Its future place in the range will follow a closer review of the source project.
quantum-999.exterior: A compelling design is understood first through its overall composition: how the volumes relate, the rhythm of its lines and the presence it creates on the water. The Quantum 999 imagery allows these questions to be explored without inventing a technical specification. The task ahead is to preserve the character of the original study while developing a coherent VELLARIO family language.
quantum-999.aboard: For Quantum 999, the next design question concerns the movement of people aboard. Access, visibility, seating and the transition between sheltered and open spaces must be considered as carefully as the boat's profile. These are priorities for future development, not finished features that can be established from renderings alone.
quantum-999.details: Every memorable object acquires its identity through smaller decisions: the edge of a surface, the feel of a fitting, the integration of a control and the balance of colour against form. The original concept will inform that design discussion. Final materials, systems and finishes are not yet confirmed.
quantum-999.specifications: Final dimensions, propulsion, equipment and classification of Quantum 999 will be published only after a definitive technical project has been approved.
quantum-999.gallery: A selection of original Quantum 999 design renderings. The evolving VELLARIO interpretation will be developed from the authentic archive.
quantum-999.enquiries: A personal introduction channel is being prepared. Contact details will be published when a verified recipient and response process are available.
quantum-999.englishTagline: The Beauty of a Clear Idea

mas-36.lead: MAS 36 brings together the elegance of a classic sporting motorboat and an unmistakably automotive influence. The original design archive explores the pleasure of a long weekend on the water through a distinctive exterior and an intelligently adaptable interior.
mas-36.concept: The historic MAS 36 project was conceived as a modern interpretation of an established sporting boat language, drawing on the shapes and confidence of mid-twentieth-century automotive design. Rather than reproduce a period boat, the study seeks a balance between cultivated leisure and a more energetic character. Its original design provenance is retained in this presentation.
mas-36.exterior: The archival design proposed a folding bimini concealed within the backrest of the aft seating, integrating protection without disrupting the cockpit's clean appearance. A sunbathing area and the relationship between open space and shelter formed part of the original proposal. These are features described in the historic design documentation, not confirmed VELLARIO production equipment.
mas-36.aboard: The original MAS 36 arrangement proposed an adaptable space: a dinette capable of converting into a sleeping cabin, together with an independent bathroom. This flexibility gives substance to the long-weekend idea and distinguishes the design from a purely open dayboat. Any future VELLARIO interpretation will require renewed review of layouts, dimensions and construction feasibility.
mas-36.details: The MAS 36 character depends on the meeting of two worlds: the measured proportions of classic Italian motoring and the clarity of contemporary nautical design. Colour and material choices should support this balance, without allowing heritage to become mere nostalgia. Specific finishes await the next technical and creative phase.
mas-36.specifications: The historic MAS 36 press material documents a design proposal, not a current VELLARIO manufacturing specification. Dimensions and equipment require independent confirmation.
mas-36.gallery: Original MAS 36 renderings and presentation imagery. Photography takes priority where archival video quality would detract from the design.
mas-36.enquiries: A dedicated direct channel will be introduced when the future customer relationship is ready to operate.

mas-56.lead: MAS 56 introduces a different scale of presence within the collection. Its original visual archive suggests a yacht conceived to be confident in profile yet composed in character, with the life aboard considered alongside its exterior identity.
mas-56.concept: The MAS 56 study offers an opportunity to explore a broader expression of the Italian sporting motor yacht. Its identity should stand independently, not simply enlarge the proportions of a smaller design. Original imagery and moving-image studies form the visual basis of this direction, while the definitive product brief remains to be established.
mas-56.exterior: The exterior story will draw on the balance of major surfaces, the continuity of the profile and the rhythm of the deck arrangement visible in the source renderings. The object should remain the centre of the presentation, without unrelated footage or invented performance statements. The objective is a presence that feels both assured and restrained.
mas-56.aboard: A greater presence on the water should correspond to an equally considered experience for the people aboard. Circulation, moments of privacy and opportunities to gather together are priorities for the next design phase. The final arrangements and amenities will be described only when supported by a reviewed project layout.
mas-56.details: The intended interpretation calls for disciplined treatment of finishes, connections and exterior detailing. Every surface should support the overall character of the yacht rather than compete with it. Materials, equipment and engineering choices remain matters for technical validation, not decorative assumptions.
mas-56.specifications: MAS 56 is the confirmed collection name. The future VELLARIO edition, including dimensions, propulsion and arrangement, has not yet reached an approved technical definition.
mas-56.gallery: Original MAS 56 imagery only, including exterior perspectives and model-specific moving-image studies.
mas-56.enquiries: Details of the future personal introduction process will be published when the service is operational.
mas-56.englishTagline: The Pleasure of Being in Motion

grantender-72.lead: GranTender 72 began as an ambitious preliminary styling study, presented in its original archive as a 72-foot PowerMachine. It imagines a tender with the confidence and presence of a substantial sporting yacht.
grantender-72.concept: The original GranTender proposal was conceived to give the idea of a tender greater visual authority and a stronger sense of occasion. The archived presentation includes exterior perspectives, preliminary layout work and studies of cockpit and saloon. These provide a genuine foundation for a distinctive new interpretation without implying the concept has entered VELLARIO production.
grantender-72.exterior: The original preliminary styling concentrates on a sporting stance and a strongly recognisable silhouette. Its visual intention is to communicate energy even at rest, holding the composition together instead of fragmenting it with ornament. The archival title is an indication of original design intent, not a verified specification for a future vessel.
grantender-72.aboard: The study considers much more than the outside. Its presentation includes separate explorations of the cockpit and saloon, evidence that the on-board experience was part of the original design conversation. The next phase must determine how those spaces should function together and which elements are appropriate to carry forward.
grantender-72.details: GranTender calls for details that feel purposeful: the meeting of seating and surrounding surfaces, the integration of controls and fittings, and the touchpoints people remember from a day on the water. CAD and rendering files are available in the archive, but they are not proof of approved production materials or finished equipment.
grantender-72.specifications: The 72-foot description belongs to the original preliminary PowerMachine study, not a certified production specification for VELLARIO. No propulsion or performance claims are made.
grantender-72.gallery: GranTender 72 renderings and preliminary design imagery, kept distinct from every other yacht in the collection.
grantender-72.enquiries: The design house will publish a verified personal contact channel when it is ready to receive enquiries.

gran-marlin.lead: Gran Marlin originates in a large motor-yacht study that translated the character of the classic sportfisherman into a more architectural, contemporary form. It introduces a distinct open-water perspective to the developing VELLARIO collection.
gran-marlin.concept: The original Gran Marlin 46 concept began with an intriguing question: what happens when the sporting identity of a fisherman yacht is translated into the proportions and spaces of a much larger motor yacht? Its answer combined recognisable references with a cleaner architectural expression. Gran Marlin remains the working VELLARIO collection name, not a transfer of historic technical certifications.
gran-marlin.exterior: The archival design preserved references such as an elongated bow pulpit while shifting major volumes towards the stern. That decision was intended to free generous space forward and offer a new relationship between the yacht's sporting lineage and its social life. This dialogue between recognisable nautical character and contemporary architecture is central to the study.
gran-marlin.aboard: The original proposal explored a generous social area forward, a more private organisation of the owner's accommodation and a carefully considered separation of guest and service spaces. These are design concepts documented in the historical archive, not a description of a completed or equipped VELLARIO yacht.
gran-marlin.details: A particularly distinctive idea in the source study was the relocation of the tender garage towards the centre of the yacht, allowing the aft area a closer relationship with the water. This is the kind of decision that interests VELLARIO: technical planning considered for the human experience it could make possible.
gran-marlin.specifications: The source Gran Marlin 46 was a large motor-yacht concept. Its original dimensions and classifications are not current VELLARIO production claims.
gran-marlin.gallery: Original Gran Marlin design archive imagery, reflecting the project's authentic offshore inspiration and original scale.
gran-marlin.enquiries: A direct introduction channel will appear alongside the future verified commercial information.

brandLexicon.policy: Italian navigation and memorable poetic headlines; clear supporting copy in international English; natural Italian phrases only. No French brand positioning vocabulary.
englishVoice: For the Love of the Water
brandLexicon.voiceRule: Italian remains the primary brand identity and navigation. English builds the second emotional layer with selective cinema straplines and editorial underscoring. Use evocative but concrete English that celebrates Italian good living. Do not imply production, heritage, showroom or personalised services already exist.
